observed.detail: Small 0-6-2T tank locomotive, cab at rear (-X), cylindrical boiler along X, smokebox at nose (+X), short rear bunker, low continuous running plate.

Exactly three large coupled spoked axles visible along the side; one rear wheel partly obscured by cab step. No leading wheel is drawn; cylinders occupy the forward lower area. Dark rims and spokes with warm brass crank pins and coupling rods.
Charcoal/near-black barrel, round smokebox at nose, two raised domes, tall open chimney, thin warm metal boiler bands and handrails; brass pipes and small fittings.

Rear box cab with gently curved roof and thin warm trim. Two oval side windows and one forward-facing arched spectacle window. Coal piled in an open rear roof bunker. Cab side includes a large open access area; no glass in that opening.
One small lamp near the top/side of the smokebox and two lamps at the front buffer beam, one on each side. Warm metallic housings and pale lenses.
Dark graphite body with subtle lighter charcoal planar faces, narrow muted gold/bronze line work. Black wheels, steel tyres, brass accents. No baked cast shadow is part of the asset.
